interpretation.working_topology: Two series diode junctions: R anode -> S midpoint -> L cathode
interpretation.support: R-S and S-L each read 0.6 V; R-L reads their 1.2 V sum; every reverse direction reads OL
interpretation.confidence: Strong support for terminal behavior; probable internal topology because measurements were made in circuit
interpretation.transistor_candidate: Simple PNP junction behavior would share a common cathode/base, unlike this directed chain. FMMT2907R is downgraded from its marking-only lead; external board paths prevent absolute exclusion.
interpretation.bav99_comparison: Same series topology as BAV99, but this is not a part identification or replacement recommendation. Nexperia specifies A7 plus a site code, not 4P. Its functional mapping would be R=A1, S=K1/A2, L=K2; existing photo-pad/native numbering is not thereby validated.

external_resistance_followup.interpretation: All four outer-pad rail checks returned high resistance. Neither R nor L has a demonstrated direct copper connection to VDD or GND; the proposed simple GND-to-VDD clamp is unsupported. The numbers are in-circuit readings, not four discrete resistors, OL, or evidence of a defective component. User explicitly confirmed R-VDD = 0.99 Mohm before the separate L measurements.
